crossRefs.note: He said, “Naked I came out of my mother’s womb, and naked will I return there. Yahweh gave, and Yahweh has taken away.…
As for me, I said in my prosperity, “I shall never be moved.”
You, Yahweh, when you favored me, made my mountain stand strong; but when you hid your face, I was troubled.
because of your indignation and your wrath; for you have taken me up and thrown me away.
You sweep them away as they sleep. In the morning they sprout like new grass.
In the morning it sprouts and springs up. By evening, it is withered and dry.

The vine has dried up, and the fig tree withered; the pomegranate tree, the palm tree also, and the apple tree, even…

translations.web: But God prepared a worm at dawn the next day, and it chewed on the vine, so that it withered.
translations.bsb: When dawn came the next day, God appointed a worm that attacked the plant so that it withered.
translations.kjv: But God prepared a worm when the morning rose the next day, and it smote the gourd that it withered.
translations.asv: But God prepared a worm when the morning rose the next day, and it smote the gourd, that it withered.
